title: JIRA Testcase Generation
overview: An AI-assisted workflow that produces positive and negative testcases from entering JIRA user story ID, based on the stories requirements and acceptance criteria.
problem: Time taken to generate manual testcases froim requirements and probability of missing some edgecases.
solution: A guided agent extracts requirements and acceptance criteria, proposes all positive and negative testcases and provides output in a csv format.

title: Steam Player Tracker
overview: An AI agent to compare Playercount of top 10 games with highest player count
problem: A personal project to check Open-AI's feasibilily and reach to retrieve and process player data and produce a report and summary between two times
solution: using Steam DB and open AI api tokens to acheive data and process that into a summary
